details.completeness_justification: K1, K3, K4, K5 and K7 are fully represented. K2 is only partially covered (passenger and cruise growth mentioned but route-specific details and Tallinn-Stockholm decline omitted). K6 and K8 are entirely absent.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. Each sentence builds logically on the previous ones: revenue decline is explained (S2), offset by other revenue streams (S3–S4), followed by a clear explanation of cost reductions (S5–S6) that drive profitability gains (S7–S11). Volume and operational metrics (S13–S16) are presented without contradiction, and the capital, debt, and cash-flow statements (S17–S18) align with the dividend distribution (S19). The forward-looking statement (S20) follows naturally from the reported results. No self-contradictions, logical gaps, or organizational issues are present.
